note: Old-brand matches that brand-crawl.mjs does not count. A match is allowed when one of these regexes (flags default "i") matches a range of the page covering the whole old-brand match. Optional "window" (chars searched around the match, default 400, 0 = whole document). Optional "urls" limits a pattern to page URLs matching that regex. Keep this list short: every entry hides text from the check.

patterns.why: Any absolute URL (links, src, srcset, canonical, sitemap, feed links, JSON-LD @id/url). The domain learncardano.io and plugin paths such as /plugins/cardanopress/ are not visible copy.
JSON-escaped URLs (https:\/\/learncardano.io\/...) in inline scripts and JSON-LD.
URL-carrying attributes whose value contains learncardano / learn-cardano / cardanopress (slugs, image file names).
Bare domain mentions in lower-case technical contexts and email addresses (hello@learncardano.io).
Lower-case identifiers only (case-sensitive): CSS classes, ids, handles (cardanopress-*, learncardano-*). Capitalised copy is still caught.
Rank Math website_alternate_name / Organization alternateName keeps the old name on purpose.
The community Discord server is still named "Learn Cardano" (invite discord.gg/V6mZGYUPNW, seen in quiz 26291's result message). Verify the server name before relying on this.

Archive, search and feed pages list historical episodes and posts whose titles/excerpts keep the old name (historical content is not rebranded). Only on those URLs and only inside <article> cards / RSS <item>s (window 0 = whole document). Review INFO by running without this entry once.
